verdicts.reason: Both look the same: the long headline is crammed into four lines of a 90px-tall leaderboard, the body copy is around 7px and can't be read, and the 'Reserve a Case' button is tiny and pushed against the right edge. The white logo panel takes up a lot of width while the logo and the 'Limited Summer Release' label inside it are small. Neither cuts the body copy for this banner format, so both are cramped strips of illegible text.
